description: Manages ZFS file system delegated administration permissions, which allow unprivileged users to perform ZFS operations normally restricted to the superuser.

parameters.name: descendents
parameters.description: Apply permissions to name‘s descendents (zfs allow -d). Choices: false true

parameters.name: everyone
parameters.description: Apply permissions to everyone. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: groups
parameters.description: List of groups to whom permission(s) should be granted.

parameters.name: local
parameters.description: Apply permissions to name locally (zfs allow -l). Choices: false true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: File system or volume name, for example rpool/myfs.

parameters.name: permissions
parameters.description: The list of permission(s) to delegate (required if state=present). Supported permissions depend on the ZFS version in use. See for example https://openzfs.github.io/openzfs-docs/man/8/zfs-allow.8.html for OpenZFS.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Unallow permissions recursively (ignored when state=present). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether to allow (present), or unallow (absent) a permission. When set to present, at least one “entity” param of users, groups, or everyone are required. When set to absent, removes permissions from the specified entities, or removes all permissions if no entity params are specified. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: users
parameters.description: List of users to whom permission(s) should be granted.

examples:
- name: Grant `zfs allow` and `unallow` permission to the `adm` user with the default local+descendents scope
  community.general.zfs_delegate_admin:
    name: rpool/myfs
    users: adm
    permissions: allow,unallow

- name: Grant `zfs send` to everyone, plus the group `backup`
  community.general.zfs_delegate_admin:
    name: rpool/myvol
    groups: backup
    everyone: true
    permissions: send

- name: Grant `zfs send,receive` to users `foo` and `bar` with local scope only
  community.general.zfs_delegate_admin:
    name: rpool/myfs
    users: foo,bar
    permissions: send,receive
    local: true

- name: Revoke all permissions from everyone (permissions specifically assigned to users and groups remain)
  community.general.zfs_delegate_admin:
    name: rpool/myfs
    everyone: true
    state: absent
